description: This file declares functions, macros, enums, and structures related to WAN network utilities, including DHCPv6/v4 client control, IPv6 address management, interface configuration, and MAPT (Mapping of Address and Port Translation) features. It serves as a header for the WAN manager network utilities in a network management project.

methods.name: WanManager_StartDhcpv6Client
methods.description: Starts the DHCPv6 client on the specified virtual interface and interface type.

methods.name: WanManager_RestartDhcpv6Client
methods.description: Restarts the DHCPv6 client for a given virtual interface and interface type.

methods.name: WanManager_StopDhcpv6Client
methods.description: Stops the DHCPv6 client on the specified virtual interface, with optional release.

methods.name: WanManager_StartDhcpv4Client
methods.description: Starts the DHCPv4 client on the specified interface.

methods.name: WanManager_StopDhcpv4Client
methods.description: Stops the DHCPv4 client on the specified interface.

methods.name: WanManager_RestartDhcp6c
methods.description: Restarts DHCPv6 client with additional parameters for interface name and IP configuration.

methods.name: WanManager_IsApplicationRunning
methods.description: Checks if a specific application is running.

methods.name: WanManager_Ipv6PrefixUtil
methods.description: Performs operations on IPv6 addresses for a given interface.

methods.name: WanMgr_IsPIDRunning
methods.description: Checks if a process with a specified PID is running.

methods.name: isModuleLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a kernel module is loaded.

methods.name: WanManager_ProcessMAPTConfiguration
methods.description: Processes MAPT configuration received from DHCP6 server.

methods.name: WanManager_VerifyMAPTConfiguration
methods.description: Verifies the MAPT configuration data.

methods.name: WanManager_DisplayMAPTFeatureStatus
methods.description: Displays the status of MAPT feature.

methods.name: WanManager_CalculateMAPTPortRange
methods.description: Calculates the MAPT port range based on provided parameters.

methods.name: WanManager_ResetMAPTConfiguration
methods.description: Resets MAPT configuration data.

methods.name: WanManager_AddDefaultGatewayRoute
methods.description: Adds default IPv4 gateway route.

methods.name: WanManager_DelDefaultGatewayRoute
methods.description: Deletes default IPv4 gateway route.

methods.name: WanManager_GetBCastFromIpSubnetMask
methods.description: Calculates broadcast address from IP and subnet mask.

methods.name: WanManager_AddGatewayRoute
methods.description: Adds an IPv4 gateway route.

methods.name: WanManager_get_interface_mac
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address of a network interface.

methods.name: WanManager_getGloballyUniqueIfAddr6
methods.description: Gets globally unique IPv6 address of an interface.

methods.name: IsDefaultRoutePresent
methods.description: Checks if a default route is present on an interface.

methods.name: WanManager_AddIfaceMarking
methods.description: Adds marking to an interface for QoS or other features.

methods.name: WanManager_CheckGivenTypeExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific interface type exists.

methods.name: WanManager_CheckGivenPriorityExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific priority exists among interfaces.

methods.name: WanMgr_StartIpMonitor
methods.description: Starts IP monitoring on an interface.

methods.name: WanManager_IsNetworkInterfaceAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is available.

methods.name: WanManager_IsNetworkInterfaceUp
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is up.

methods.name: WanMgr_RdkBus_AddIntfToLanBridge
methods.description: Adds interface to LAN bridge via RDK bus.

methods.name: WanManager_PrintBootEvents
methods.description: Prints boot event logs.

methods.name: IsValidIpAddress
methods.description: Validates if an IP address string is valid for a given family.

methods.name: WanManager_send_and_receive_rs
methods.description: Sends and receives Router Solicitation messages.

methods.name: WanManager_Wait_Until_IPv6_LinkLocal_ReadyToUse
methods.description: Waits until IPv6 link-local address is ready.

methods.name: WanManager_SendRS_And_ProcessRA
methods.description: Sends RS and processes RA for IPv6 address configuration.
